title: IronSalvage
description: Salvage your gold tools and armor for some extra gold ingots!
body:
This datapack adds simple crafting recipes to turn iron tools and armor back into iron ingots. You can salvage your iron items by putting them in the crafting table to receive majority of the iron ingots you used to make the tool.

Helmet -> 3 iron ingots

Chestplate -> 5 iron ingots

Leggings -> 4 iron ingots

Boots -> 2 iron ingots

Sword -> 1 iron ingot

Pickaxe -> 2 iron ingots

Axe -> 2 iron ingots

Shovel -> 2 sticks (to prevent infinite recycling of shovels)

Hoe -> 1 iron ingot
